summary: I extracted 30 frame grids (4x3 at 2-6 fps), 14 crops at 12/24 fps (S009, S013, S037, S038, S053/S054 swaps, S058, S066, S072, S078, S083, S102, S106) and a lip-sync check on 8 dialogue close-ups (S017, S026, S052, S064, S083, S086, S100, S108). For that check I tiled 12 fps face crops against the engine's own vo_data envelope. V2 is a real step up. The VO bug is fixed, and mouths now open on syllables and close in pauses on every CU I checked (S026 'Wait... what?' opens on both words and shuts in the gap). Heads tilt and nod while talking. Blinks are irregular, with occasional doubles. Walks are stride-locked: S098, S103, S016 and the S053 extras no longer skate. Most pose changes are now blended keyframes with a little anticipation (S013 wind-up, whiff and smear, S078, S083 lean-back then outBack plus shake, S038 kick-to-cheer, S106 walk-in). Four things keep it well below the Ifverse bar. (1) Several fixes only half-landed. The S066 screwdriver still teleports, now to y=1005, under the letterbox, so it simply vanishes. The S058 typing arm runs at 75 rad/s, which aliases at 24 fps into a two-frame strobe. The S053/S054 object swaps scale in from 0, which leaves an empty frame showing Eli's legs. The S072 robot moves at only 222 px/s, so it still looks parked. (2) Bodies are still frozen in long dialogue and reaction shots: no torso sway, no gestures, no listener nods (S099, S100, S090, S020, S036 hold, S108). (3) Mouth amplitude is pinned at 1.0 on 32% of dialogue frames and jumps more than 0.35 on 21% of frames, so mouths gape and flutter instead of shaping words. 'shout' and 'panic' mouths never close, even after the line ends. (4) The boolean sit flag in mixPose pops the hips by a frame or two at every stand-to-sit transition, and S106 reads as a dip and hop.
strengths: Lip sync now works on every dialogue CU tested (S017, S026, S052, S064, S083, S086, S100, S108): the mouth follows the real per-line envelope with no offset, opens on stressed syllables and returns to the expression's resting mouth in pauses.
Talking head life: rig.js character() adds noise tilt (±2.2° idle, +4.5° while talking) and a talk-driven nod, rotating the whole head group about the neck. It shows in S064, S086 and S100.
Stride-locked walks (walkPh = dist / 0.63h) match the rig's actual stride (thigh 60 + shin 57, ±24° swing). No skating in S098, S103, S016 or the S053 extras.

S013 now reads as a gag: a 4-frame wind-up, a whiff just over the ball with leg ghosts, an 85°→78° overshoot-and-settle fall, landing shake, the ball dribbling 340 px with ease-out, and a dazed blink.

Pose blending via poseAt/mixPose replaced the hard ternaries. S037 reps, the S038 kick → cheerBounce, S078 panic and S084 Noah rising all ease, and S083 has a 4-frame lean-back before the outBack shout.
Hash-driven blinks with 2-4 s gaps and occasional doubles, plus 2.2% breathing, mean characters no longer blink in lockstep.
S108 callback: 3/4 → front snap with outBack in 6 frames, shock → bewildered, then a late slow blink. The comedic structure is there.
S023 got a real 'take' (head scale 1→1.08→1 with a blink before shock).

v1_followup.v1_issue: ALL dialogue: no lip sync (VO_DUR bug)
v1_followup.note: Verified on 8 CUs by tiling 12 fps face crops against vo_data env: mouths open on syllables and close in gaps, with no time offset (env is lead-trimmed and mix.py places audio at start - lead). Remaining amplitude problems are listed as a new issue.
Head tilt and nod while talking now exist and show. But there is still no torso sway (no lean noise in rig.js), so long CUs and two-shots have a moving head on a frozen body (S099, S100, S090).
Blends to P.sitFacepalm (outBack 1.3–1.6 s, out 2.4–2.8 s), no pop. New problem: the open book is drawn over Eli's face for the whole shot, so the eye-rub can't be seen (see issues).

v1_followup.v1_issue: S013 kick misses by 150 px, no smear, dead landing
v1_followup.note: Whiff over the ball, ghosts, rot overshoot, shake, ball roll. Minor: the 1.5 s post-fall hold is frozen except one blink (no leg twitch or dust).

v1_followup.v1_issue: S036/S037/S038 ternary pose pops, no ball contact
v1_followup.note: Poses now blend. But in S037 the kick peaks while the ball is near head height (ball arc starts at ph=0 at x=980, foot nowhere near), so there's no contact. S036 has no shin recoil or flinch, then a 2.6 s static facepalm. In S038 the cheer arm passes across the face for 3 frames.

v1_followup.v1_issue: S066 screwdriver teleports to bench, linear push
v1_followup.note: At k ≥ .99 the tool jumps from the hand (y≈820) to PR.screwdriver(n.handF[0], 1005): bench rect at y 1010, under the 60 px letterbox, and pushed further down by the 1.08 zoom. So it vanishes mid-hold. CAM.push is still 'lin'. Head drop and blink were added.

v1_followup.v1_issue: S072/S095 no sense of speed; S095 wheels spin after stop
v1_followup.note: Seams, posts, speed lines and jitter were added, and S095 wheelRot is now tied to k. But x = lerp(300,1600) over 5.9 s is only 222 px/s with the camera locked, so the seams and fp 1.6 posts barely move (posts sit at nearly the same screen x across 10 frames at 24 fps). S095 has no overshoot or nose-dip.
walkPh stride lock verified visually. A new slide appeared in S102 (see issues).
They now translate, but they're still about 45 px tall and the walk can't be read.

v1_followup.v1_issue: S053/S054 object swaps are 1-frame pops, Eli frozen
v1_followup.note: Out-scale (to .6) and in-outBack exist, but sIn = E.outBack(clamp(f/.12)) starts at scale 0, so the circuit swap has an empty frame showing Eli's raised-leg legs. Cube→chess still pops in one frame, there are no smear ghosts or whoosh arcs, and the per-object workPose arm changes are invisible front-on (T-pose throughout). The book hides Eli completely.

fa = 52 + 22·sin(t·75) is 11.9 Hz, almost exactly Nyquist at 24 fps. The front arm alternates 30°/74° every frame (computed and confirmed in 24 fps crops), which reads as a strobe or glitch rather than blur. Eli stands instead of sitting, and his hands don't reach the laptop. Noah's 'page turn' is a 10° arm wobble.
S023 has a take and blink. S026 (shock → bewildered at 0.5 s), S108, S100b (neutral → smug) and S013 still switch expression on a single frame with no blink or head pop.

S078 (lean -6 then outBack panic, shake 3), S083 (lean-back 4 frames, outBack shout, 0.3 s shake) and S084 (Noah crossArms → shout blend) are fixed. S090 'LEFT SIDE!' is still a static P.point() from frame 1 with no hit or hold vibration.
cheerBounce with phase offsets reads in S098 and S102. S011 laughers are tiny and still stiff in the body.

The S102 bump has anticipation and contact, but Noah slides about 160 px in P.stand (feet skate), the heads interpenetrate for the rest of the shot, and Eli's 25 px recoil is barely visible. S099/S100 have no gestures, weight shifts or listener nods.
3/4 → front snap with outBack in 0.25 s, shock → bewildered, slow blink. New pose problem listed below (P.sit arms read as a starfish in CU).

v1_followup.v1_issue: S093 robot slides through barrier, no turn
v1_followup.note: Now rotates and rises into depth. In 2D the ±12° rot reads as a wheelie or hop rather than a yaw, and the barrier never occludes the robot.
Hash gaps of 2–4 s with doubles and 2.2% breath. The blink is a binary 0.12 squash (no half-closed in-between frame) but reads fine.

issues.problem: The film's key emotional beat still breaks. The screwdriver disappears from Noah's hand at t≈3.0 s and is redrawn at y=1005, under the bottom letterbox and further hidden by the 1.0→1.08 push, so the viewer sees it vanish. There's no hesitation hold, the arm lowers with one inOut, and the push is still linear.
issues.fix: act3.js S066: raise the bench to y≈880 (S.rect(300,880,1400,40)) so it's in frame at z 1.08. Keep the tool attached at n.handF while k<1, then over 6 frames ease it from handF to [handF[0], 875] (E.out) with rotation 80°→4°→0° (outBack), and play tool_place on the contact frame. Keys: k = kf(c.t, [[1.2,0],[2.2,.85,'inOut'],[2.45,.85],[3.0,1,'in']]) for a 6-frame hesitation before release. CAM.push(960,520,1.0,1.08,'sine').

issues.problem: Aliasing strobe: fa = 52+22·sin(t·75) is 11.9 Hz at 24 fps, so the arm flips between 30° and 74° on alternate frames (a 2-state flicker). The 4 ghosts at dt .025 land on the same two phases. Eli is standing and his hands never reach the laptop, so 'blurring speed' doesn't read.
issues.fix: act3.js S058: never animate above ~6 Hz with a sine at 24 fps. Use fast = t => ({...P.sitType(t), fa:[58+18*Math.sin(t*2*Math.PI*5), 40+10*Math.sin(t*2*Math.PI*5+1)], ba:[54+18*Math.sin(t*2*Math.PI*5+Math.PI), 44]}). Seat Eli (sit:true, y = stool top) with hands on the laptop keys (laptop at handF). Draw ghosts as arm-only copies at dt .012/.024/.036, op .35, and add 3–4 short speed ticks around the hands. Noah: a real page-turn every 1.2 s (ba 20°→120° outBack, holdSvg book page rect rotating).

issues.problem: Mouth amplitude is pinned and noisy. vo_data.py normalises env to the 95th percentile, then speakAmp multiplies by 1.6 and clamps, so 32% of dialogue frames sit at 1.0 (mouth fully open for runs of 8–10 frames, e.g. L064) and 21% of frames jump >0.35 frame-to-frame (single-frame snaps shut). 'shout'/'panic' mouths ignore talk entirely and stay open for the whole shot, including after the line ends (S086 4.75 s, S083, S090).
issues.fix: timeline.js speakAmp: drop the gain to 1.0 and smooth with attack/release: a = env[i] > prev ? lerp(prev, env[i], .7) : lerp(prev, env[i], .35) (precompute a smoothed env per line in vo_data.py). Add a 1-frame lead (index i+1) so the mouth opens just before the sound. Map amp → openness with a soft knee (o = 1-(1-a)^2 * .85) and modulate saturated runs with .15*sin(t*2π*7) so held vowels still move. rig.js face(): for 'shout'/'panic' scale the open shape by (.35 + .65*talk) when talk>0 and fall back to a small closed shout mouth when talk<.05.

issues.problem: The robot still looks parked. x = lerp(300,1600) over 5.9 s is 222 px/s and the camera is locked to it, so the seams (160 px apart) crawl and the fp 1.6 posts move about 19 px per 10 frames. The speed lines are fixed to the robot and don't streak.
issues.fix: act3.js S072: x = lerp(0, 9000, c.p) (≈1500 px/s), seams every 160 px at p 1 and posts every 900 px at fp 1.8 (≈2700 px/s whip-past, give the fg layer horizontal-only blur by scaling the post rect x by 2.5 instead of a gaussian). Camera leads the robot: cam.x = x + 100 + 40*Math.sin(c.t*1.3). Speed lines: 5 lines with length 200–400 px that flicker every 2 frames (hash(floor(c.t*12)+i)). Add a 3 px chassis bounce at 9 Hz on top of the noise jitter.

issues.problem: mixPose treats sit as a boolean (t<.5 ? a : b) and drawFigure sets hipY = 0 when sit is true, otherwise it's lowest-foot height. Halfway through a blend the hips drop (legs half-bent) and then snap when the flag flips. With outBack ey this reads in S106 as Eli dipping below the floor and hopping onto the stool, the hop V1 asked to remove.
issues.fix: rig.js: make sit numeric. In mixPose lerp booleans as numbers (Number(va), Number(vb)). In drawFigure: const standY = -Math.max(legs.fl[1][1], legs.bl[1][1]); hipY = lerp(standY, 0, pose.sit||0). S106/S016: use E.inOut, not outBack, on ey, add a 3-frame 'drop' (+6 px, then settle) after contact, and end the walk with a short stop step (walk phase eased to .5 over the last 0.25 s).

issues.problem: The swaps still pop. sIn = E.outBack(clamp(f/.12)) starts at scale 0, so the circuit swap shows a frame with no object and Eli's legs (one raised) visible below the T-posed body. Cube→chess changes in 1 frame. There are no smear ghosts or whoosh arcs, and the per-object workPose differences are invisible front-on (arms stay out). The book covers Eli entirely.
issues.fix: act2.js obsession(): sIn = .6 + .4*E.outBack(clamp(f/.25)), sOut = f > .85 ? 1 - .4*E.in((f-.85)/.15) : 1. During the last 15% draw ghosts(dt => outgoing obj offset by dt*-900 px in x, 3, .03, .3) plus a white whoosh arc path. Draw the desk in front of Eli's legs (desk top at y≈1000) so the legs never show. Front-view working poses: cube (fa/ba [100±12 sin(2π·4t), 120] elbows in, hands meet at the cube), chess (one hand reaching down fa [130, 30], head tilt -6), book (hold the book lower at y 1050 so the face stays visible, page flip every .4 s), circuit (lean 12 with headDrop 10, hands at the board).

issues.shot: S099 / S100 / S090 / S108 / S020 (long holds)
issues.problem: Bodies are frozen. There's no torso sway, weight shift or gesture in 3–5 s dialogue shots (S099 Eli P.stand for 3.8 s, Noah crossArms; S100 3 s). The S090 'LEFT SIDE!' point is static from frame 1. Only the head moves, which reads as a bobble-head on a cut-out.
issues.fix: rig.js character(): add idle sway if o.lean is undefined: pose.lean += 1.5*noise1(t*.5+sd) and bob += .8*Math.sin(t*TAU*.3+sd) (shoulder rise with breath). Add arm micro-motion: fa[0] += 3*noise1(t*.7+sd). act3.js S099/S100: on stressed words (L071 'sorry', L073 'need') blend fa to [40,90] for 8 frames, and give Noah a listener nod (nod 0→5→0 over 0.4 s) at L071 end. S090: poseAt(c.t, [[0,{...P.shout(),lean:-6}],[.12,{...P.point(),lean:10},'outBack']]) + 10-frame vibration lean ±1.5 at 18 Hz + shake 3 for 4 frames.

issues.problem: No foot-ball contact. The ball arc (by = 860 - sin(ph·π)·340, starting at x 980) begins its rise at ph=0, but repPose(ph) peaks the kick when the ball is already near head height and ~200 px from the foot. Reps read as a kid kicking air while a ball floats beside him.
issues.fix: act2.js S037: align phase so the kick contact is ph=0. Put the ball's ground point at the kick foot's world position: expose footF from drawFigure joints (rot(legs.fl[1])) and character() returns footF. Then ball x0 = footF[0] at the contact frame. repPose keys: [[0,P.kick()],[.15,P.stand(),'out'],[.8,P.kickWind(),'inOut'],[1,P.kick(),'out']]. Add a 2-frame ball squash (scaleY .8) on contact.

issues.problem: The shoulder bump skates and collides. Noah moves 1160→1000 in P.stand (both feet planted, sliding about 160 px), then his head overlaps Eli's face for the rest of the shot. Eli's 25 px recoil with rot is barely visible.
issues.fix: act3.js S102: give Noah one step: pose = walk phase from walkPh(1160-x, 580) during the approach. Cap contact at x ≥ 1060 so the heads stay ≥ 1.1·R apart. Lean Noah's torso (lean +14) into the bump rather than translating. Eli: hit 45 px, rot -hit*.4 with outBack recovery, then both 'laugh' (headTilt -10, bob 4 at 5 Hz) for the hold.

issues.problem: The action can't be seen. The open book is drawn in front of Eli's head for the entire 3.8 s shot, so the 'rubs his eyes' facepalm is hidden and the shot reads as a book with legs.
issues.fix: act1.js bedroomDesk(): draw the book flat on the desk top (PR.openBook at desk y, skewed) instead of upright at head height, or lower it 140 px so the face is above it. Then the sitFacepalm blend (1.3–2.8 s) reads, and you can add 2 head shakes (headTilt ±6 at 3 Hz) during the rub.

issues.problem: Expression changes still pop on a single frame (S026 shock → bewildered at 0.5 s, S108 shock → bewildered at 0.85 s, S100b neutral → smug at 0.9 s). The callback faces lack the head 'take' that S023 now has.
issues.fix: rig.js: add exprAt(t, [[t0,'shock'],[t1,'bewildered']]) that returns blink:true for the 2 frames around each switch. Add a shared take(c, t0) helper (scale 1→1.08→1 over 6 frames, lookY -.3) and use it on S026 and S108 at the shock onset so the callback matches beat for beat.

issues.problem: P.sit seen front-on in a CU puts both forearms out horizontally at frame edges, so Eli reads as a starfish or meditation pose rather than a kid seated at a piano. There's no piano edge to anchor it.
issues.fix: act3.js S108: use {...P.sitPiano(c.T, 0), fa:[30,40], ba:[30,40]} (hands low and forward, out of frame) and add PR.keysTop at the bottom edge like S107.

issues.problem: The 'swerve into depth' reads as a wheelie or hop: a 2D rot of ±12° tilts the chassis like a car jumping, and the barrier never occludes the robot.
issues.fix: act3.js S093: replace rot with a yaw fake. Scale x by cos(yaw) (scaleX 1→.8→1) while keeping the wheels on the ground plane (y follows the floor perspective), and draw the barrier in the fg layer while the robot is behind it (c.p .3–.6).

issues.problem: The shin trap has no physical reaction (no leg recoil or flinch), then holds a static facepalm for about 2.6 s while the ball rolls off.
issues.fix: act2.js S036: at k=.95 add a 4-frame fl hip -20° recoil and headDrop 6. Make the facepalm a breathing hold with one head shake at 2.2 s, and cut or ease the camera 6% toward Eli during the hold.

issues.problem: The cheerBounce arm sweeps across the face for 3 frames on the way up, so the celebration silhouette is muddy, and the 'net bulge' shakes the whole goal frame sideways.
issues.fix: act2.js S038: route the arm via an intermediate key [1.0, {...P.kick(), fa:[90,20]}] so it rises outside the head. Animate only the net mesh (PR.goal option bulge: displace the back-net path by net px), not the posts.

issues.problem: The walkers translate now but are about 45 px tall under the title. The walk cycle can't be read and adds noise.
issues.fix: act1.js S006: h ≥ 110 and keep them in the lower third under the door spill, or drop them and let the title move carry the shot.
